status: Frozen before new phase predictions; existing published maps and prior line-localization results were already known
model: A-hn finalist seed 0 only; individual model_score, not TRACE times the mean of three A-hn members
normalization: uint8 intensities clipped at 200, converted to float32 and multiplied by 1/255; no resampling
tile_admission: at least 25 percent positive source layer-20 pixels in the entire 64x64 input tile
tta: identity only, matching the published A-hn finalists
precision: FP32 for both phases; CUDA TF32 disabled; source reference maps were made in FP16
stitch: float32 sum of tile probabilities times normalized Gaussian divided by float32 weight sum

field.selection: 10 mm horizontal interval centred on published claim-box midpoint; both supplied row centres plus at least 3.5 mm outward flank support; no selection from new scores
field.output_orientation: reading orientation: native render crop flipped vertically
field.coordinate_limit: Uses the already frozen public line-control crop convention; source annotation interpolation versus native rounding differs by about one pixel
field.device: CUDA required; no automatic full-field CPU fallback
field.validity: same source layer20>0 AND positive accumulated tile weights in both phases; all required published render chunks must have been hash verified
field.ranking: unchanged line_review Config, including thresholds 0.25/0.5/0.75; no retuning if there are no proposals; compare phases on identical physical field and intersection mask
field.primary_endpoints: Per published row: top1/3/5/10 centreline and coarse box coverage; first rank attaining at least 50 percent centreline coverage, or explicit not attained
field.secondary_endpoints: Common-mask score differences and threshold disagreement; these are stability measures, not text accuracy

micro.purpose: True input-tile placement check only; not a line-ranking or reading experiment
